description: Set how many of a product are in the user's Picnic shopping cart, e.g. when the user says "make it 3". 0 removes the product. Get the product id from get_cart or search_products. Returns the quantity now in the cart and the cart total.

productId.description: The product id from search_products or get_cart, e.g. s1004201.

quantity.description: How many should be in the cart. 0 removes the product.

name: set_cart_quantity
title: Set cart quantity
